notes.title: Patch Notes - July 17, 2025
notes.content:
Fixed the issue where dragging a popup warning caused the window to remain on screen after clicking

Fixed the issue where synergy effects didn’t update properly after switching drivers

Added auto-loot for dropped items

Fixed the issue where window wasn’t centered after changing resolution

Fixed D-pad not working on controllers

Added multilingual support: Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, and more
Thanks for all your feedback and support! Feel free to keep sending suggestions — we’ll keep improving the experience!

notes.title: BROTANK – Hotfix Patch Notes
notes.content:
[olist]
Fixed an issue where setting the volume to 0 would cause problems when minimizing the game window

Fixed a crash when switching to the Settings menu from the Store or Pause screen and then going back

Fixed inconsistent rotation speed on SpikeArmor, which now correctly scales with attack speed

Fixed a crash when swapping tank positions
[/olist]
Thanks again for playing BROTANK! Feel free to share more feedback—we’re constantly improving the game.

notes.title: Demo Update Patch Notes | New Difficulty, New Synergies, Lots of Fixes
notes.content:
✅ System Update

Difficulty 2 is now unlocked.
[hr][/hr]
🧨 Equipment Updates

Added a new synergy between Energy Blades and Energy-Draining Machine Gun with Molotov.

Spike Armor:

Now rotates faster based on attack speed.

Added synergy with Molotov.

Rotation formula updated; visual assets updated as well.
[hr][/hr]
🛠️ Other Optimizations

Burning status warning added: burning will no longer kill the tank—it will leave it at 1 HP.

Dropped items (skill books, supplies) will no longer get stuck in buildings.

Buildings will no longer overlap when generated.

Flame and oil tile effects reworked.

Pause menu now shows correctly before the result screen.

Added a black screen dialogue guide at game start.

UI guidance now appears only after moving the tank to the right.

Fixed monsters getting stuck when dashing into buildings.

Store now supports the pause menu popup.

Fixed translation issues in socketing interface in English mode.

Optimized word wrapping for weapon descriptions in upgrade/shop/warehouse interfaces.

Items you cannot afford, sockets, and refreshes are now marked in red.

Improved drag-and-drop performance for equipment.

Equipment synergy effect prompts are now more noticeable.

Installable slots are now always visible.
[hr][/hr]
🐞 Bug Fixes

Fixed Fireproof Armor effects disappearing when switching tank positions.

Added missing English description for Energy-Draining Machine Gun.

Fixed boss not dying bug.

Fixed issue where synergy count in store updated but bonus effect info did not.

Fixed bug where replacing tank gear via keyboard didn’t trigger fusion in warehouse.

Fixed minimap navigation rendering issue.
[hr][/hr]
📢 Final Note
We hope you enjoy the new content! If you have any feedback, suggestions, or bug reports, feel free to leave a comment. We're continuously working to improve the experience and bring you a better tank-building roguelike!
